title: Strict local root algebra domain and puncture etaleness
statement: For a commutative ring H with [IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing H] and [IsRegularLocalRing H], an element h with [IsRegularLocalRing (H ⧸ Ideal.span {h})], IsSMulRegular H h, and h in the maximal ideal, and n with 0 < n and IsUnit (n : H), let C = AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H)^n - Polynomial.C h), q = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C)), and V = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C h) in Spec (CommRingCat.of C). Then IsDomain C and Etale (V.ι ≫ q).

proof.text: The monic root algebra C is finite over H. Evaluation at t=0 in the residue field of H is a surjection ε. For every maximal ideal M of C, integrality implies its contraction is the maximal ideal of H. Hence t^n=h lies in M, and primeness gives t in M. Evaluation of any polynomial modulo M therefore equals evaluation of its constant term; its membership in M is exactly vanishing of its residue under ε. Thus M=ker ε, proving C local, with t in its maximal ideal. All these assertions are proved explicitly using AdjoinRoot.lift, Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal, and IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal.

Apply localization_at_prime_and_isRegularRing to H/(h), at its maximal ideal, to supply IsRegularRing (H/(h)). Apply isRegularLocalRing_atPrime_of_root_mem to C at its maximal ideal, using injective multiplication by h and t in that ideal. The localization at the maximal ideal of a local ring is isomorphic to C by IsLocalization.atUnits. Transport regular locality back to C, and apply the proved upstream IsRegularLocalRing.isDomain instance.
Apply root_split_away_cover_etale to CommRingCat.of H, h, n, hn to obtain precisely Etale (V.ι ≫ q), and pair it with the domain conclusion.
